env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
# A fork-only standard-library selector has no upstream spelling
# (SPEC T-0.3): logos build accepts it, but logos eject must refuse it
# at its source location instead of reporting a successful eject.
# The direct EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect call is exempt: eject rewrites it
# to the GODEBUG-guarded stock form (see logos_eject_h2extendedconnect).
# This case keeps a method value, which no rewrite covers, so eject must
# still refuse it here.
logos build ./...
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'server\.lgo:6.*fork_stdlib_api.*EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect'
! exists out

cd ../ok
# The stock-library control ejects cleanly.
logos build ./...
logos eject -o out
exists out/server.go

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/h2portability

go 1.27

-- m/server.lgo --
package h2portability

import "net/http"

func Enable(s *http.Server) {
	f := s.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect
	_ = f
}

-- ok/go.mod --
module example.com/h2ok

go 1.27

-- ok/server.lgo --
package h2ok

import "net/http"

func KeepAlive(s *http.Server) {
	s.SetKeepAlivesEnabled(true)
}
